title: Signal or Noise? Auditing Rotation-Induced Saliency Drift in Medical and Aerial Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2609.02224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-hoc saliency maps such as Grad-CAM are increasingly used to audit why a deployed vision model made a decision, yet the heatmap drifts when the input is rotated, even when the prediction is unchanged. In domains with no canonical orientation, such as histopathology and aerial imagery, this undermines using saliency as evidence. We ask whether that drift is faithful signal or noise introduced by the CAM operator, and answer it by measuring equivariance at every stage of the operator rather than inferring it from the network's output. The instability is not where one would guess: the channel weights are the most rotation-stable stage, and on ResNet-50 exactly stable, because a GAP+linear head makes the class gradient field spatially constant. translated_title: 信号还是噪声？审计医学与航空影像中旋转诱发的显著性漂移
translated_abstract: 诸如Grad-CAM等事后显著性图被越来越多地用于审计已部署的视觉模型为何做出某个决策，然而当输入被旋转时，即使预测结果不变，热力图也会发生漂移。在没有规范方向的领域（如组织病理学和航空影像）中，这削弱了将显著性作为证据的可靠性。我们探究这种漂移究竟是忠实的信号还是CAM算子引入的噪声，并通过测量该算子每个阶段的等变性而非从网络输出进行推断来回答这一问题。这种不稳定性并不出现在人们通常猜测的位置：通道权重是最具旋转稳定性的阶段，且在ResNet-50上完全稳定，因为GAP（全局平均池化）加线性头使类别梯度场在空间上恒定。真正发生变化的是空间激活张量，而分类器自身的池化操作恰恰丢弃了这种变化。一项因果测试证实了其后果：遮挡那些显著性发生漂移的像素会给预测带来代价（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现Grad-CAM等显著性图在图像旋转时的漂移并非来自通道权重（后者因GAP+线性头结构而完全旋转稳定），而是源于分类器池化所丢弃的空间激活张量的变化，表明这种漂移可能是CAM算子引入的噪声而非模型决策的忠实信号。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that rotation-induced saliency drift in Grad-CAM stems not from channel weights (which are exactly rotation-stable due to the GAP+linear head) but from the spatial activation tensor that the classifier's pooling discards, suggesting the drift is noise introduced by the CAM operator rather than a faithful signal of the model's decision.
